accepted_scope: Explicit required input roles, canonical relative selected paths, complete tree files and directories (including empty directories), content lengths/hashes and mode bits are captured. Symlink/special-file input rejection is retained.

Two snapshots detect observed intervening membership/content changes. File reads compare descriptor identity before/after and path identity; documentation correctly disclaims atomic or continuous filesystem snapshot protection.

Each binary requires actual file SHA relationships to distinct supplied build/execution receipt inputs. JSON-pointer hash/map/equality/literal bindings compare serialized typed values and reject duplicate keys/non-finite literals.
Lock output must be outside selected files/trees and is created exclusively; verification is read-only and requires a separate expected lock SHA before parsing relationships.

Unresolved descriptions and explicitly selected environment values are retained. No process environment enumeration, hardware query, Rust/product/benchmark execution or release promotion is performed.
scope_limits: Source-map, source-commit, build-option/profile and report relationships beyond mandatory binary receipt hashes are caller-supplied bindings. A concrete input specification must be separately reviewed for those relationships; presence of a role alone is not their validation.

Receipt authenticity, actual past execution and completeness of the selected source/build inputs are not certified by this lock. It complements the existing cc-eval manifests and does not replace their binary_source_binding warning.
P8-001 remains preparation-only with P7-020 dependency and wider release obligations unresolved. No complete P8-001 or release-candidate acceptance is claimed.

findings.problem: A correctly externally pinned non-object JSON lock reaches lock.get and raises uncaught AttributeError. CLI returns 1 and traceback instead of documented invalid-input exit 2.
findings.requested_change: Validate that the parsed lock is an object before accessing fields, and preserve a narrow CLI regression control.
